blocks.text: The SAFAVIEH Gianni Arm Chair offers a modern take on British Colonial style, blending woven rattan accents and bamboo-inspired open arms with a solid natural mahogany wood frame and plush 100% cotton cushion for lasting comfort. Each chair is crafted from real wood, so slight variations in grain, tone, and texture are completely natural—enhancing its unique, one-of-a-kind character. Perfect for coastal, tropical, or bohemian interiors, the Gianni brings breezy sophistication to dining rooms, living areas, or sunrooms. For the best fit, please ensure your table has a minimum clearance height of 26.8 inches to allow the chair's arms to slide comfortably underneath.

items.label: [DESIGNER DETAILS]
items.value: Bring timeless tropical style to your home with this SAFAVIEH arm chair, featuring a sculpted silhouette and woven rattan backrest for a relaxed yet refined coastal look

items.label: [DURABLE CONSTRUCTION]
items.value: Expertly crafted from solid mahogany wood with a soft 100% cotton cushion for lasting durability and comfort; natural grain and tone variations highlight the wood’s unique, handcrafted beauty

items.label: [PERFECT SIZE FOR ANY ROOM]
items.value: Measures 21.5" W x 23.5" D x 34" H; seat height 19.8", backrest 14", armrest 26.8"; weight capacity 220 lbs.; ensure table clearance of at least 26.8" for the chair’s arms to fit comfortably underneath

items.label: [EASY ASSEMBLY]
items.value: Includes step-by-step instructions to make assembly easy and hassle-free

items.label: [TRUSTED BRAND]
items.value: SAFAVIEH has been a trusted home furnishings leader for over 100 years, loved by millions and consistently rated 4★ and above; start your search with SAFAVIEH and explore 100,000+ top-rated rugs and furniture pieces

items.label: [BASED IN NEW YORK]
items.value: Based in New York, SAFAVIEH operates 13 stores across NYC, Long Island, Westchester, Stamford, and New Jersey; With deep roots in design and rug craftsmanship, SAFAVIEH doesn’t just sell rugs and furnishings—they create trends
